entries.title: JSON-RPC gets a private stdout, so library output cannot corrupt a response
entries.summary: Suite parity with jdocmunch 1.129.0. fd 1 now points at stderr for the whole process; the framed stream is reachable only by the transport. The handshake watchdog stays — launcher chatter written before we start is already in the pipe.

entries.title: Kotlin and Bash constants are extracted, and a declared pattern must now prove itself
entries.summary: Reported by @mussonking (#428) against Rust, confirmed across six languages.

entries.title: A blank line inside a table cell no longer truncates it
entries.summary: Silent data corruption in the MUNCH decoder. Found in-house.

entries.title: Retrieval confidence grades ranking quality, not units
entries.summary: Found while fixing the same defect in jdocmunch ([#106](https://github.com/jgravelle/jdocmunch-mcp/issues/106)) and checking whether the siblings shared it. jcodemunch did. jdatamunch does not — it has no confidence surface and blends linearly, so this is a two-server defect rather
